note: Read 2026-10-31 in КонсультантПлюс's free online texts (consultant.ru), which reproduce the official texts in their current editions; the official portal pravo.gov.ru answered 503 and kremlin.ru didn't answer, so the source is marked secondary. Majority: Civil Code part one (30.11.1994 N 51-FZ, edition of 10.06.2026), art. 21(1): full civil capacity arises with majority, at eighteen; art. 21(2): a person allowed to marry under eighteen gains full capacity on marriage, and art. 27's emancipation from sixteen (not held). Work: Labour Code (30.12.2001 N 197-FZ, edition of 25.05.2026), art. 63: a labour contract may be made from sixteen; from fifteen for light work after general education; from fourteen, with a parent's written consent, for light work outside school hours (not held). Performers: art. 63, part four: in film organisations, theatres, theatre and concert organisations and circuses, a contract may be made with a person under fourteen to take part in creating or performing works, with a parent's (guardian's) consent and the permission of the guardianship authority (орган опеки и попечительства); the permission states the hours and conditions (not held). No lowest age. Service: Federal Law 'On Military Duty and Military Service' (28.03.1998 N 53-FZ), art. 22(1)(a): men aged eighteen to thirty on (or bound to be on) the military register and not in the reserve are subject to call-up (the upper age was twenty-seven until the 2023 amendment in force 1 January 2024); art. 38(1)(d): those called up after 1 January 2008 serve twelve months. Women aren't called. Not held: deferments, alternative civilian service, and mobilisation of reservists.
